classification.evidence_level: The current level is an explicit documented/discovered/callable/observed input; repeated requires at least two distinct run and pack identities under one exact matrix digest, all observed, one repeatable outcome, and no contrary run. classification.repetition: The summary retains total, same-outcome, contrary-run, and sorted outcome counts. Duplicate runs, reused packs, conflicting packs, and matrix mismatch are rejected.
classification.confidence_inputs: Confidence remains a descriptive input set: complete observation, named SDK/outer channel count, digest count, matched/missing facts, contradictions, limitations, repetitions, and contrary runs. It is not a score and cannot change outcome.
classification.reachability: A retained evidence digest binds the capability observation. Pre-effect runtime interception is runtime_enforceable; post-effect runtime interception is observable_only; host-only, missing-integration, and no-observation states map to host_enforceable, code_change_required, and blind respectively.

adversarial_matrix.unsupported_control_claim: Missing evidence identity, invalid stage, and stage/interception contradiction are rejected.
